h1.en: How Harrow Skate Park arranges a note that only repeats delivery hose versus straight delivery pipe
h1.zh: 《Harrow Skate Park》怎样安排一篇只重复delivery hose versus straight delivery pipe的笔记

directAnswer.en: For delivery hose versus straight delivery pipe, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Harrow Skate Park. Harrow Skate Park only lends its headings. Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes both a delivery hose and a straight delivery pipe. They are separate product pages. The hose has no DN table. The pipe has no DN table either, and six pump pages supply an inner diameter only for the pipe cell.
directAnswer.zh: 写delivery hose versus straight delivery pipe时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Harrow Skate Park》借数字。《Harrow Skate Park》只出借标题。 河北品锦机械同时公布了输送胶管和直管，是两张产品页。胶管没有公称直径表。直管也没有公称直径表，六台泵只给管子格子提供了内径。

body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Rubber delivery / placing hose, steel couplings, project-quantity packing, quote after pump model, DN and length. No list price. No service life. Red enamel straight pipe, reinforced coupling or flange ends. Inner diameters that are actually printed sit on Electric 20 (80 mm), Electric 15 (100–125 mm) and four pages at 100 / 125 mm. Wall thickness is missing on the pipe page. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “历史”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 橡胶输送 / 布料胶管，金属接头，按工程量包装，对照泵型号、管径和长度报价。无公开标价。无寿命。 红色涂层直管，加强快接或法兰端。真正印出的内径在电动20（80 mm）、电动15（100–125 mm）和四台 100 / 125 mm 的页面上。直管页缺少壁厚。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “Features” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Say hose or straight pipe in the first line. Do not ask for a hose length using a pump's conveying-distance metres. Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes both a delivery hose and a straight delivery pipe. They are separate product pages. The hose has no DN table. The pipe has no DN table either, and six pump pages supply an inner diameter only for the pipe cell. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “特点”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 第一行写明是胶管还是直管。不要用泵的输送距离米数去当胶管长度。 河北品锦机械同时公布了输送胶管和直管，是两张产品页。胶管没有公称直径表。直管也没有公称直径表，六台泵只给管子格子提供了内径。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Access” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. No. Each page has its own factory photo. This note follows the page you are ordering. The elbow is a separate DN200 R275 90° part. The hose page does not print DN200. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “来源章节：Access”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 不能。每页有自己的工厂照片。本文跟着你要订的那一页。 弯管是单独的 DN200 R275 90° 配件。胶管页没有印 DN200。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “In popular culture” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, via the contact page. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrow_Skate_Park
body.zh: “来源章节：In popular culture”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械，通过联系页。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrow_Skate_Park
